_comment: Manual escalation path for emergencies scripts/check_emergency.py's automated NWS feed cannot see on its own -- most importantly, a county-issued evacuation order relayed only through La Plata County's own resident notification system (LPC Alerts, formerly branded CodeRED), which has no public API and will never show up in the NWS alerts feed. Set active to true and fill in category/headline/details/source to force an immediate, review-free emergency post: within about 10-15 minutes on the next scheduled check, or within seconds if you push this file's change to GitHub directly (see .github/workflows/emergency-alert.yml's path trigger). category must be exactly one of: flood, fire, evacuation, disaster. Set active back to false once the situation is resolved -- that stops future posts about it, but does NOT automatically post an 'all clear' message; post that yourself if you want one out. Editing headline/details/source while active stays true (e.g. updating an evacuation order's details) is treated as new information and posts again. NOTE (added 2026-07-24): there is now a SECOND, independent way to trigger this same kind of alert -- a restriction.override flag on your own govallecito-conditions Worker (see scripts/check_emergency.py's _check_worker_override() for the field contract). Use whichever is easier to reach in the moment; they don't conflict.
